reviews.x: Liked everything except the performance! The "grit" is too course. I've had glass nail files before and have been very very pleased. I would never use them if these had been my introduction.

reviews.t: Glass nail files are not all the same!
reviews.x: It took a while to find a quality glass nail file, one that had a finely-etched abrasive surface.  NOT this file.  This item has a rather rough surface, and I'm not sure that it is etched, as opposed to presenting a secondary abrasive adhered to the glass.  So far, the only file that meets my expectations is made by VAGA.  It's the real thing.  As far as I can determine, most of the low-cost files are not acceptable.  Nice little individual protective cases though...
These are okay but are a little too thick for my liking and very rough. They do the job but would not purchase again.

I love these, they are so cute and colorful but the purple one in my opinion doesnt look like the photos, to me it looks just a bit darker than the pink one so it looks more fusha. I rated it 4 stars because I have a texture problem as well as a noise problem (certain textures and sounds repulse me or make my skin crawl) and I thought the glass files would be more smooth on the file part than Emery boards which I absolutley hate touching but it wasnt that much different. The smooth part to hold

I've had glass nail files before.  Glass nail files are fragile, so you have to take care of them. These all came in an individual case, which makes taking care of them easier. I have very soft nails, and they split horizonally down in the nailbed.  The smoother my nails are, the better they preform without splitting.  These files work great for fine nails.  I cannot speak for thick nails.

What a pleasant surprise when I opened the package and found how wonderfully made and packaged they were. I am very impressed with the quality and the file is strong enough to file your nails without harming them. I have purchased the diamond cut ones and they were too harsh on my nails, these are great!
I do like they come in individual cases,

Great product for the price! I feel they could be a little more fine on the coarseness and the cases are kinda just a cheap plastic that don’t stay together right, like when you open it the other side comes off. It’s not a big deal and for the price, it’s WONDERFUL! If you want a high quality product, pay more for a high quality product because this is just an AWESOME average. They will make nice gifts and they work well for my needs.

reviews.t: amazing product along with amazing price everybody needs one
reviews.x: First time I saw these was at a craft show I paid and unbelievable price and everyone borrowed it and liked it and I thought why not look on Amazon so I bought these at an amazing price and now all of my friends have one they are great and you will never have to buy another nail file

I've bought these twice now in the last 6 years. (I've also shared some with my household now) They're wonderful items and as long as you aren't trying to break them, they'll stay whole! I keep one in my purse even so it's jostled around quite a bit daily and is fine!

reviews.t: The only Nail File you'll ever need!
reviews.x: If you have never used a glass nail file, you are about to discover the best files ever made! They last forever unless you break them, which is fairly hard to do. I used to buy for a small store and glass files were always selling out! ( And these are very pretty!)

I needed these for a gift quickly and ordered them with prime and I received 6 but not of all the colors like the picture shows and one of them was shattered in the case that I almost cut myself. Not happy with this purchase at all and don’t have time to return it.

I feel so fancy when I use these. I got them cause simplynailogical recommended glass nail files and I like these a lot. I did accidentally sit on one and was very sad when it broke so be careful! Put them back in their cases and don’t leave them lying around lol.

Like many people, I bite my fingernails.  Horrible habit that I have found i can avoid if I file the rough edges.  This set provided 6 files, each in an individual case to store in convenient locations so I can avoid temptation.  Great deal for the money!

reviews.t: Excellent product but one broken file
reviews.x: The product is fine..excellent.  Six came in the package. However, One of the six files was broken inside the container.  Disappointing since I paid for six and had to discard one.  Not happy with a broken file but happy with the product itself.

Really love glass files and the carrying case for each one is super. However these files are very rough making filing a bit difficult compared to what I have bought in the past. If after some use they smooth out a little I will update.

Glass, I love glass, and colors I love colors and nail files, I love nail files, so I love these.  The cases are very nice and will help me not lose these.  The colors oh my, are nice.  So, what more can anyone say?

Purchased a bunch to give as small gifts to all of my coworkers. Everyone loved them! The cases are plastic, but the files are nice and very pretty. Tons of compliments about how nice and useful they are.
These files work well and were a good value.  The included case was a nice addition, ithe center section of it needed to be glued to one side but did not affect the overall quality of the files.
This is too rough - your better off with an emery board. It frays the nails with the back and forth action, unlike the other Czech crystal files I have. Cheap substitute, so I returned it.
These nail files come in a brushed silver case that looks really classy. The files themselves are sturdy and rough on both sides, where the files I already had only have 1 rough side.
I am loving these nail files. I was a little skeptical at first because they seemed to be a little bit cheap compared to other brands. But they work great and I haven’t broken one yet
I liked the fact that they had hard cases. That  made it easy to throw the file into a purse and not need to worry about it being broken. I also liked The fact they were a nice size.

reviews.t: PERFECT for applying Color Street polish strips
reviews.x: I do my nails with color street about once a week and these work perfectly for that! I'm able to not only shape my nails but get rid of the excess nail strips without tearing them.
Glass files are extraordinary. I've ordered many in my life.  This particular batch comes nicely packaged with its own holder, but they are not as effective as others I've had.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the files too rough or coarse for their liking.
Reviewers appreciate that each file comes in its own individual case.
Several reviewers praise the value and price of the set.
Some reviewers received broken or shattered files, and one noted missing colors.
Reviewers describe the files as durable and long-lasting if cared for.
